globalThis.fontMatchCase = async (variant) => {
  const checks = {};
  const prefix = `NimboMatch${variant}`;
  const bytes = await fetch(`/font-assets/font/${variant}`).then(response => response.arrayBuffer());
  const all = [];
  const add = (family, descriptors = {}, source = bytes) => {
    const face = new FontFace(family, source, descriptors);
    document.fonts.add(face);
    all.push(face);
    return face;
  };
  const choose = async (name, descriptors, query, expected, text = 'A') => {
    const family = `${prefix}${name}`;
    const faces = descriptors.map(descriptor => add(family, descriptor));
    const result = await document.fonts.load(query.replace('$', family), text);
    checks[name] = JSON.stringify(result.map(face => faces.indexOf(face))) === JSON.stringify(expected);
  };
  await choose('weight400', [{weight:'300'},{weight:'500'},{weight:'600'}], '400 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('weight450', [{weight:'400'},{weight:'500'},{weight:'600'}], '450 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('weight500', [{weight:'400'},{weight:'600'}], '500 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('weight350', [{weight:'300'},{weight:'400'}], '350 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('weight550', [{weight:'500'},{weight:'600'}], '550 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('weightRange', [{weight:'300 600'},{weight:'400 500'},{weight:'450'}], '450 12px $', [2]);
  await choose('bolder', [{weight:'400'},{weight:'700'}], 'bolder 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('lighter', [{weight:'100'},{weight:'400'}], 'lighter 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('widthBelow', [{stretch:'75%'},{stretch:'125%'}], 'normal 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('widthAbove', [{stretch:'100%'},{stretch:'150%'}], 'expanded 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('widthRange', [{stretch:'75% 125%'},{stretch:'normal'}], '12px $', [1]);
  await choose('widthBeforeStyle', [{stretch:'condensed',style:'normal'},{stretch:'expanded',style:'italic'}], 'italic 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('styleBeforeWeight', [{style:'italic',weight:'100'},{style:'normal',weight:'700'}], 'italic bold 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('italic', [{style:'normal'},{style:'italic'},{style:'oblique'}], 'italic 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('normal', [{style:'normal'},{style:'italic'},{style:'oblique'}], '12px $', [0]);
  await choose('oblique', [{style:'normal'},{style:'italic'},{style:'oblique'}], 'oblique 12px $', [2]);
  await choose('normalOblique', [{style:'italic'},{style:'oblique 20deg'},{style:'oblique 5deg'}], '12px $', [2]);
  await choose('italicFallback', [{style:'normal'},{style:'oblique 20deg'},{style:'oblique 5deg'}], 'italic 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('obliqueHigh', [{style:'oblique 5deg'},{style:'oblique 30deg'}], 'oblique 20deg 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('obliqueLow', [{style:'oblique 5deg'},{style:'oblique 30deg'}], 'oblique 8deg 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('obliqueNegative', [{style:'oblique -30deg'},{style:'oblique -5deg'}], 'oblique -20deg 12px $', [0]);
  await choose('obliqueRange', [{style:'oblique 0deg 30deg'},{style:'oblique 20deg'}], 'oblique 20deg 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('rangesA', [{unicodeRange:'U+41'},{unicodeRange:'U+42'},{unicodeRange:'U+41'}], '12px $', [0,2]);
  await choose('rangesAB', [{unicodeRange:'U+41'},{unicodeRange:'U+42'},{unicodeRange:'U+41'}], '12px $', [0,1,2], 'AB');
  await choose('rangeEmpty', [{unicodeRange:'U+0-10FFFF'}], '12px $', [], '');
  await choose('rangeExcluded', [{unicodeRange:'U+42'}], '12px $', []);
  await choose('astral', [{unicodeRange:'U+1F600'},{unicodeRange:'U+41'}], '12px $', [0], '\uD83D\uDE00');
  await choose('surrogate', [{unicodeRange:'U+D800'},{unicodeRange:'U+FFFD'}], '12px $', [0], '\uD800');
  await choose('rangeAfterWeight', [{weight:'400',unicodeRange:'U+42'},{weight:'700',unicodeRange:'U+41'}], '12px $', []);
  await choose('compositeWeight', [{weight:'300 600',unicodeRange:'U+41'},{weight:'300 600',unicodeRange:'U+42'}], '450 12px $', [0,1], 'AB');
  await choose('compositeWidth', [{stretch:'75% 125%',unicodeRange:'U+41'},{stretch:'75% 125%',unicodeRange:'U+42'}], '12px $', [0,1], 'AB');
  await choose('compositeAngle', [{style:'oblique 0deg 30deg',unicodeRange:'U+41'},{style:'oblique 0deg 30deg',unicodeRange:'U+42'}], 'oblique 20deg 12px $', [0,1], 'AB');
  await choose('groupBeforeRange', [{weight:'300 600',unicodeRange:'U+41'},{weight:'450',unicodeRange:'U+42'}], '450 12px $', []);
  await choose('narrowInterval', [{weight:'300 600'},{weight:'400 500'}], '450 12px $', [1]);
  await choose('reversedIntervalOrder', [{weight:'400 500'},{weight:'300 600'}], '450 12px $', [0]);
  const quoted = add(`${prefix} Quoted`);
  checks.quoted = (await document.fonts.load(`12px "${prefix} Quoted"`, 'A'))[0] === quoted;
  const fold = add(`${prefix}Straße`);
  checks.caseFold = (await document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix.toLowerCase()}STRASSE`, 'A'))[0] === fold;
  const sigma = add(`${prefix}Σ`);
  checks.sigmaFold = (await document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix}ς`, 'A'))[0] === sigma;
  const accented = add(`${prefix}å`);
  checks.noNormalization = (await document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix}a\u030A`, 'A')).length === 0;
  const first = add(`${prefix}First`);
  const second = add(`${prefix}Second`);
  const listed = await document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix}Second, ${prefix}First, ${prefix}Second`, 'A');
  checks.familyOrder = listed.length === 3 && listed[0] === second && listed[1] === first && listed[2] === second;
  checks.missing = document.fonts.check(`12px ${prefix}Missing`) && (await document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix}Missing`)).length === 0;
  checks.generic = document.fonts.check('12px serif') && (await document.fonts.load('12px serif')).length === 0;
  const remote = add(`${prefix}Remote`, {unicodeRange:'U+41'}, `url('/font-assets/font/${variant}')`);
  checks.unloaded = remote.status === 'unloaded' && !document.fonts.check(`12px ${prefix}Remote`, 'A');
  checks.defaultSpace = document.fonts.check(`12px ${prefix}Remote`) && (await document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix}Remote`)).length === 0;
  checks.excludeUnloaded = document.fonts.check(`12px ${prefix}Remote`, 'B');
  remote.load = () => { throw new Error('page override'); };
  const pending = document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix}Remote`, 'A');
  checks.loading = remote.status === 'loading' && !document.fonts.check(`12px ${prefix}Remote`, 'A');
  const loaded = await pending;
  checks.loaded = loaded.length === 1 && loaded[0] === remote && document.fonts.check(`12px ${prefix}Remote`, 'A');
  const failed = add(`${prefix}Failed`, {}, `url('/font-assets/missing/${variant}')`);
  try { await document.fonts.load(`12px ${prefix}Failed`, 'A'); checks.failed = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.failed = error.name === 'NetworkError' && failed.status === 'error' && !document.fonts.check(`12px ${prefix}Failed`, 'A'); }
  try { document.fonts.check('nonsense'); checks.checkSyntax = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.checkSyntax = error.name === 'SyntaxError'; }
  try { await document.fonts.load('nonsense'); checks.loadSyntax = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.loadSyntax = error.name === 'SyntaxError'; }
  try { document.fonts.check(); checks.checkRequired = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.checkRequired = error instanceof TypeError; }
  try { await document.fonts.load(); checks.loadRequired = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.loadRequired = error instanceof TypeError; }
  try { document.fonts.check.call({}, '12px serif'); checks.checkReceiver = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.checkReceiver = error instanceof TypeError; }
  try { await document.fonts.load.call({}, '12px serif'); checks.loadReceiver = false; }
  catch (error) { checks.loadReceiver = error instanceof TypeError; }
  checks.coercion = document.fonts.check({toString:()=>`12px ${prefix}Remote`}, {toString:()=> 'A'});
  for (const face of all) document.fonts.delete(face);
  return checks;
};
